description: Completed Flutter shell with voice intents, Mia tasks, theme packs, and a multi-source Calendar — synced with Chrome extensions for tasks and invites.

description: Completed Chrome MV3 extension that pastes or scrapes calendar invites into Firestore so they appear on the Mia Calendar agenda.

title: Mia Task Capture
description: Completed Chrome MV3 extension that pastes or selects text into structured Mia tasks — category, priority, and due date — written to Firestore.

title: Nokia Snake
description: First HTML, CSS, and JavaScript project: a 10×10 div-grid remake of the old Nokia snake, from February 2023. Playable on this site.

title: YouTube Clone
description: Early HTML and CSS layout of a YouTube home page, from February 2023. Sidebar, search bar, and a grid of video cards. Viewable on this site.

title: Emotion Detection

title: Face Mask Detection
description: Notebooks that resize faces to 100×100, train a two-class CNN, and label a webcam face as mask or no mask.

title: Income Prediction

title: Login Page

title: Voice Command Canvas

title: Sentiment Alpha Research
description: NLP-driven sentiment analysis pipeline extracting tradeable signals from financial news, social media, and analyst reports.

title: Time Series Forecaster
description: Deep learning based multivariate time series forecasting system for financial and macroeconomic indicators.

title: Crypto Market Maker
description: Automated market making bot for crypto exchanges implementing inventory management and spread optimization strategies.
